refresh.title: Refresh trend data
refresh.help: Fetch latest data runs the Trends refresh workflow: it reads the newest arXiv cs.AI listing, scores it and publishes a dated snapshot. A failed run publishes nothing and the current snapshot stays live. Re-score uses only the signals already stored and publishes only if they measure a newer period.
refresh.inProgress: Run in progress: ingesting, scoring and validating…
refresh.alreadyRunning: A refresh is already running; showing that run.
refresh.lastGoodStays: The last published snapshot stays live.
refresh.rescore_no_new_data: No new data: snapshot {date} already covers the stored signals. Nothing was published.
refresh.rescore_failed: Re-score failed; nothing was published. Snapshot {date} stays live.
refresh.notConfigured: Fetching from this page is not configured on the server. Run the "Trends refresh" workflow manually from the repository's GitHub Actions tab (Run workflow).
refresh.forbidden: Only administrators listed in ADMIN_EMAILS can refresh trend data.
refresh.pollTimeout: Stopped checking after 35 minutes. Check the run on GitHub.
refresh.error: The refresh request failed ({code}). The current snapshot stays live.
